pr_title: This PR enables the pushing down of arbitrary expressions into scans. A

labels.summary: Fixes an index bug in filter pushdown to scans where `erase_at(i--)` followed by `pushdown_results.erase_at(i--)` removed the wrong pushdown_results entry and skipped filters, so the filter and result lists became misaligned; the fix erases both at `i` and decrements once.
